verdict.rationale: llamafile runs entirely on the user's device with no cloud or data sharing, so user data never sits in a vendor silo (llamafile-docs-2, llamafile-docs-15, corroborated by llamafile-comm-6). It runs open GGUF models, and a llamafile is a documented bundle of executable plus weights (llamafile-docs-8, llamafile-docs-17), so leaving carries little lock-in. However, the evidence shows no explicit export feature, missing for 10: documented export of chat or session data in open formats, documented extraction of GGUF weights from a built llamafile, and independent hands-on corroboration of data portability.
